text: Yes?
zh: 什么事？

text: Welcome to our sacred temple, my child.
zh: 欢迎来到我们的圣殿，我的孩子。

text: Unlike many others, you have proven to endure the dangers of this temple.
zh: 与许多人不同，你已经证明自己能够经受住这座神殿中的凶险。

text: Which secrets do you want to share with me?
zh: 您想与我分享什么秘密？

text: Who were the others?
zh: 那些人都是谁？

text: I am ready to be one of you.
zh: 我准备好成为你们的一员了。

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: Take care of yourself, my child.
zh: 照顾好自己，我的孩子。

text:
This temple holds an artifact unlike any other.
It has been the source of our powers for centuries.
zh:
这座神殿中藏有一件举世无双的神器。
数个世纪以来，它一直是我们力量的源泉。

text: To protect the artifact and drive away intruders we had to spread rumors about a fictional monster in the swamp.
zh: 为了保护神器、驱走闯入者，我们不得不散布谣言，编造出一头栖身沼泽的怪物。

text: Only a few dared to come into the swamp to look for the monster, so we trapped them in our temple for them to die.
zh: 只有寥寥数人敢进入沼泽寻找那怪物，于是我们便把他们困在神殿里，任其自生自灭。

text: However, two members of the royal guard seemed to be especially strong individuals.
zh: 然而，皇家卫队中有两名成员似乎格外强悍。

text:
Their will and strength allowed them to stay alive. Over time they lost their mind due to the power of our artifact, though.
Unable to die, they are now guarding the artifact.
zh:
他们的意志与力量让他们活了下来。不过随着时间流逝，神器的力量夺走了他们的神智。
如今他们不得死去，永远守卫着神器。

text: Powers which I want to share with you.
zh: 而这份力量，我愿与你分享。

text: #:Join our cult!:#
zh: #:加入我们的教团！:#

text:
With the Arcanum Sanguis in our hands our rise will be unstoppable.
And you shall be part of this.
zh:
只要血之秘典在我们手中，我们的崛起便无可阻挡。
而你，将成为其中的一员。

text:
You won't be able to join any other faction then, but that is not of interest.
Soon, there won't be any other faction left.
zh:
到那时你将无法再加入其他任何势力，但那无关紧要。
用不了多久，其他势力都将不复存在。

text: Very well!
zh: 很好！

text:
Receive the power of our artifact.
The power of the sacred stone Erylding.
zh:
接受我们神器的力量吧。
圣石埃里尔丁的力量。

text:
With this power you shall serve our god and bring him offerings.
Collect the #:corrupt coins:# and bring them to my altar in the swamp.
zh:
凭借这份力量，你将侍奉我们的神明，并为祂献上祭品。
去收集#:堕落硬币:#，将它们带到我在沼泽中的祭坛。

text: Come to me if you want to know more about our cult.
zh: 若想深入了解我们的教团，就来找我吧。
